_readme: Per-band minimum raw confidence (SNR domain, linear encoding, 0-255) for the veet_tof_bands.py validity gate. Edit the values below after lab characterisation -- veet_tof_bands.py reads this file at import time, and VEET_TOF_Viewer.py can reload it mid-session without restarting (see reload_confidence_thresholds() in veet_tof_bands.py). Band geometry (mm ranges) is NOT here -- only confidence thresholds are lab-tunable; see VEET_TOF_INTEGRATION.md section 3.2.
provenance: preliminary bench characterisation, pre-validation -- see VEET_TOF_INTEGRATION.md Provenance
